name: AI Avatar
author: hlasensky
description: A little creatures that live on your screen edge: walks while its AI is actively working, stands and naps (zzz) when it's idle, and pops when it stops. Click it to jump to that AI's window; drag it to reposition or move it to any edge of the screen.

barWidget.description: Ambient activity mascot: walks while its AI is busy, naps when idle, pops when it stops. Click to focus that AI's window.

schema.label: Walk speed (ms per screen width; higher = slower)
